# Page 3 Summary — OIML Certificate R49/2013-A-CZ1-26.03

This page contains three main sections describing the **WMP water meters** by **ADD Production**:

## Measuring System Description
- WMP water meters are **ultrasonic water meters** with an electronic indicating device, designed to measure, memorise, and display volume of water passing through the measurement transducer
- Construction: **brass body** with connecting screw threads, one pair of ultrasonic transducers, and an electronic indicating device with **LCD display**
- Volume resolution of **0.000 001 m³** on the digital display
- No buttons; LCD display with communication interfaces
- Software separation with CRC and SW version displayed in auto-rounding menu
- Powered by **3.6V DC battery**
- Installation positions: **horizontal** (indicating device at top or side) and **vertical** (flow bottom to top)

## Marking and Inscriptions
Required markings include:
- Unit of measurement (m³)
- Numerical value Q₃ (m³/h) and ratio Q₃/Q
- OIML certificate of conformity number
- Manufacturer's trademark
- Year of manufacture and serial number
- Direction of flow arrow
- Maximum admissible pressure (MAP)
- Installation position letters (H↑, H→, V↑)
- Temperature class (T××) and pressure loss class (Δp××)
- Battery replacement date (if non-replaceable)
- Environmental classification (B or O)
- Electromagnetic environmental class (E1)
- Software version/checksum (on digital display)

## Characteristics (table begins)
| Parameter | Value |
|-----------|-------|
| Manufacturer | ADD Production |
| Model number | WMP |
| Nominal diameters | 15, 20, 25 |
| Q₁, Q₂ flowrates | Shown in Table *Basic metrological data* |

**Footer:** Verze 20-001 | Page 3 of 9 pages, with Czech Metrology Institute (Český metrologický institut) stamp.
